title: Binance Users Withdraw $3.6B Following Record Crypto Hack
excerpt: Users withdrew $3.6 billion from Binance after a major crypto hack impacted $6.3 billion in digital assets.
body_html:
Users have withdrawn $3.6 billion from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance following a record-breaking digital asset hack. The security incident impacted digital assets valued at $6.3 billion.

In response to the security breach, the exchange temporarily froze transactions while dealing with the fallout from the massive event.
